candidates.title: India’s intentions not right, Pakistan saving Kashmiris: Farooq Abdullah
candidates.excerpt: Former Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister and ruling National Conference (NC) President, Farooq Abdullah said on Saturday that the intentions of Indian state towards Kashmiris are not "right", and it is due to Pakistan's diplomatic effort that their voice are being heard globally.

candidates.title: BRS to organise Raithu Garjana Sabha in Adilabad on Nov 1
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao will attend the Raithu Garjana Sabha in Adilabad on November 1, former minister Jogu Ramanna said. The party will demand drought-hit status for the district and immediate relief for farmers affected by crop losses

candidates.title: Horrific Road Accident in East Godavari: Tipper Lorry Rams RTC Bus, Children Among the Injured
candidates.excerpt: A serious road accident occurred near Sigaramma Chinta in Gokavaram mandal of Andhra Pradesh's East Godavari district when a tipper lorry allegedly rammed into an Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (APSRTC) bus from behind.

candidates.title: Mahabubnagar: Farmers protest after alleged police assault on land compensation claimant
candidates.excerpt: Farmers have protested against the Jadcherla police over the alleged assault of Uddandapur farmer Narsimhulu, who sought compensation for land acquired for a reservoir. Videos purportedly showing police personnel dragging and verbally abusing him have circulated on social media.

candidates.title: France’s economic woes: Debt nears 122% of GDP, growth forecast at just 0.4%
candidates.excerpt: France is grappling with severe economic challenges, marked by soaring public debt nearing 122% of GDP. With government expenditure exceeding 57% of the nation's economic output, the forecast of just a 0.4% growth raises concerns over financial stability. Protests centered on the rising cost of living showcase deeper political fractures. As the presidential succession nears, the economy stands as a pivotal issue for the electorate.

candidates.title: Gangster Himanshu Bhau used fake passport to enter US, was detained by ICE during asylum bid: Report
candidates.excerpt: US ICE has taken Indian nationals Himanshu Bhau and Neeraj Kaushik into custody in Nevada. Haryana Police says Bhau is wanted in multiple cases and is coordinating with India’s CBI to expedite his deportation. He faces an Interpol Red Notice and is linked by investigators to several violent crimes.

candidates.title: Tiger Shroff firing: Turkish, desi pistols recovered in Surat, youth held in MP
candidates.excerpt: Cops have arrested Pranjal Thakaran, a 22-year-old student, regarding the recent firing incident involving actor Tiger Shroff. The police recovered a Turkish-made Zigana pistol and a country-made firearm during the investigation. Thakaran is believed to be linked to the weapon supply chain and the shooter involved in the case. The weapons were found in Surat after an extensive search effort by the authorities over several hours.
